==Description==
'''Chilly''' is an emote obtained from the [[Operation I.C.E Event#Operation I.C.E Battle Pass|Operation I.C.E Battle Pass]]. It was made by Mewious and MonoGAnim. The emote is looped and players cannot move while performing this emote. No music can be heard while performing this emote and it cannot be interacted with.

'''Chilly''' will make the player start to shiver. Snowflake particles will flow from above the players head down towards the ground. A chattering sound can be heard.

This emote could be obtained at Level 9 of the regular track, where it costed {{Bell|240}} or {{Robux|48}} to unlock it, with a total cost of {{Bell|1,150}} or {{Robux|500
}}.
